$comment: Logical signed public Publication model; public feeds are distinct from private OM ConversationEvents.

PublicationControlState.publisher_authority: principals allowed to authorize publication signing keys
PublicationControlState.signing_key_state: current/retired publication signing keys and rotation evidence
PublicationControlState.governance: authority/threshold required to change publication control state

PublicationEvent.signature: durable signature over canonical event encoding

Rule: Followers are not canonical Publication members. Mirrors may distribute posts but cannot forge publication authority. Retraction cannot guarantee erasure of already-public copies.
ControlConflictRule: Authority/signing-key control forks freeze privileged advancement until resolved under common pre-fork governance; no relay/mirror/provider chooses the canonical authority head.
